t: You're at the site of the Cockpit-in-Court, an early London theatre that stood at the Palace of Whitehall, next to St James's Park. Nothing of it is visible now, because the site is occupied by 70 Whitehall, in Westminster. The theatre was designed by Inigo Jones, who is often described as the first significant architect in England in the early modern era. He introduced the classical architecture of Rome and the Italian Renaissance to the country, and he also worked as a stage designer, which fits a man who designed a theatre.
